# `aitbc monitor campaigns`

List active or completed monitoring campaigns.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc monitor campaigns [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--status` | choice | `all` | no | Filter by status |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc monitor campaigns
```
